Page footers are hand-maintained lists that have already drifted (nist-800-171-policy-templates missing from them); adding a page meant a scripted edit across 26 files. A cta.mjs-style generated footer would remove this.

Running --for-changes narrowed the clone's sparse checkout to a few ventures, deleting the working copy of the venture I was editing (my work was already committed); it also made several local checks fail on 'sparse checkout' and missing sibling ventures. Had to `git sparse-checkout add` it back.

A local pass of `run_venture_tests.py <slug>` does not run the unwired tree checks (csv formula guard, inherited keys, table headers) that CI's changed-ventures runs; CLAUDE.md says a local pass is the CI pass. The note points at unwired_checks.py; it is worth running for a new page.

Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads are 0.1x input except 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 and 0.025x on Fable/Mythos 5.1 and 5.2. Sonnet 5.5 cache_read was 0.20 here until 2026-11-12 (quality audit round 48): records priced before then overstate Sonnet 5.5 cost.

human_equivalent.basis: a developer writing a tested calculator page with geometry, yield logic and site wiring

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
